description:
Developer Experience Writer at Halyard

Halyard builds observability tools for data teams. We're hiring a DX writer to own our technical content — reference docs, tutorials, and the occasional deep dive.

Your job
- Ship the getting-started experience: first 15 minutes for a new user, end-to-end.
- Own the reference docs. Get them accurate. Then get them scannable. Then make them a pleasure to read.
- Write 1-2 technical deep-dives per quarter. Things like 'how our query planner works' or 'the three failure modes of streaming CDC'.
- Partner with engineering on every release. Catch regressions in docs before users do.

We're looking for
- 5+ years writing technical content for developers. CLI tools, SDKs, databases — not SaaS marketing copy.
- Strong code. You read Go and Python well enough to argue with the engineer who wrote it.
- Calm editor's eye. Short sentences. Plain words.
- A public track record (blog, open-source docs, technical talks) we can look at.

Would love to see
- Experience at a developer tools company.
- Work on SQL / query engines / observability tools.
